personality_one_liner: A highly readable, trust-first interface where the local community's needs and verified experts sit front and center, feeling as reliable as a handshake.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content, comfortable vertical flow. Never cramp cards. One column layout for cards.

screens.name: Customer_Home
screens.purpose: A hub for service discovery and active job tracking, offering immediate categorization and status updates.

states.loading: Skeleton grids for categories and loading spinner for active jobs.
states.empty: Illustration of a clean home/clipboard, text 'No active jobs right now. Got something to fix?', CTA 'Post a Job'.
states.error: Text 'Could not load your feed.', CTA 'Retry'

screens.layout: Sticky header with greeting. Top section: Smart Search bar. Middle section: Category Grids (rounded tiles). Bottom section: 'Active Jobs' dashboard tracking status of pending/active tasks. A prominent Floating Action Button (FAB) or sticky bottom button for 'Post a Job'.

screens.name: Handyman_Available_Jobs
screens.purpose: Allows handymen to browse and claim local jobs within their radius.

states.loading: Map loading overlay and list skeletons.
states.empty: Illustration of a map/clipboard, text 'No jobs within your radius at the moment.', CTA 'Expand Radius'.
states.error: Text 'Unable to load local jobs.', CTA 'Retry'

screens.layout: Top toggle (Map / List). List view features cards showing price, distance, zip, and urgency badge. Sticky filter row. Map view features custom markers with job prices.

screens.name: Post_A_Job_Flow
screens.purpose: A streamlined multi-step form to collect job details, photos, and address without overwhelming the customer.

states.error: Inline validation errors below inputs in error color.

screens.layout: Progress indicator at the top ('Step 1 of 3'). 5-9 fields per step. Vertical stacked fields. 'Next' / 'Previous' buttons. Step 1: Details (Title, Category). Step 2: Location & Schedule (Address masked). Step 3: Photos & Urgency. Step 4: Review.

screens.name: Job_Details_Timeline
screens.purpose: Tracks the end-to-end lifecycle of a job, ensuring trust via verification badges, masked chat, and before/after evidence.

states.error: Text 'Unable to load job details.', CTA 'Retry'

screens.layout: Hero image (Before photo if uploaded, or category placeholder) with a gradient scrim. Below: Job Title, Price, Handyman Profile row with Trust Verification Badges (ID, License). Main body: Vertical activity timeline (Posted -> Matching -> Claimed -> In Progress). Sticky bottom action: 'Message' or 'Mark Complete'.

empty_state_clipboard.alt: Clipboard with blank paper on desk

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing heavily on iOS-Native Clean (Personality 1). Avoid all blues strictly. Use the provided Deep Moss/Forest Green brand palette.
Implement the Job Posting flow as a multi-step component (fieldset/conditional rendering approach) to reduce cognitive load on customers. Make sure 'Next'/'Back' retain state.
For the Job Timeline, build a visual vertical stepper. Include prominent 'ID VERIFIED' / 'LICENSE VERIFIED' badges near the Handyman's avatar.
Do NOT use pure blue or any purple-leaning colors anywhere in the app, even for links or info badges.
Use Phosphor icons. Keep the weight consistent across the app.

For cards containing text over images (e.g., job categories), you MUST apply the gradient scrim layer (Layer 1: expo-linear-gradient vertical 0% transparent to 100% ≥70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text contrast.
Apply Glassmorphism to the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
All interactive pressables must respect a 44x44pt hit area minimum.
Ensure the 'Post a Job' button stays sticky over scrolling content to encourage conversion.
